adjudication.rationale: The diff explicitly removes the Thor CLI option `:category, aliases: '-c'` from `lib/tasks/disqus.thor` and deletes the code that looked up `category_id` and passed `category: category_id` into `PostCreator`. It now calls `TopicEmbed.import_remote(user, t[:link], title: t[:title])`, which does not accept or set a category. This is a concrete, behavior-breaking CLI/API change: existing invocations using `disqus:import -c ...` will become an unknown-option error, and imported topics will no longer be assigned to the requested category (falling back to defaults). The additional notes about HTML/readability extraction and TopicEmbed rows are also consistent with the new code path, though the “collision” aspect is more speculative.
